summary.en-US: Private, offline-first wallet for cards, IDs, passwords, and finances

description.en-US:
A private, offline-first Android app for everything you'd otherwise keep in
a paper folder, a notes app, or a dozen different browser tabs: cards, IDs,
passwords, contacts, day-to-day finances, and client sales - all encrypted
on-device, with no cloud sync and no account to sign into.

Every sensitive field is individually encrypted with AES-256-GCM before it
touches the database, protected behind a PIN set on first launch. There is
no password recovery by design - the data is genuinely unreadable without
the PIN.

Features: Wallet (cards + IDs with photos), a password vault, a separate
contact list, Finances at a Glance (manual entry or on-device OCR statement
import, portfolio tracking, monthly PDF reports), and a Sales tracker for
services sold to clients. Drag-to-reorder, sort, and Tiles/Compact/List view
options throughout.

Built and maintained entirely by one developer, sideloaded directly - not
affiliated with any bank, employer, or company.
